node.title: Actual parameter-graph hyperplane cap and paid post-exception rank collapse
node.statement: On normalized KoalaBear rows (1048576+J,J,67472+J), any proper affine hyperplane of the actual dimension-twelve slope/explanation parameter space contains at most 156765527508668296 distinct valid bad labels, by a same-support polynomial gauge and the proved rank-ten cap. Every over-budget original rank-twelve line therefore has at least118215200602591848 labels outside each hyperplane, uniformly over valid reselections in the fixed normalized carrier. On J9941..21499 the existing secant/zero exceptions cost at most1149710068 labels. If the surviving graph lies in a proper hyperplane, the whole original line is paid by156765528658513308 including near once; otherwise an over-budget line retains at least118215199452881780 labels outside every hyperplane. This is a rank-collapse source-class payment and robust full-dimensionality restriction, not a hyperplane cover, full-dimensional census, complete degree interval or Prize closure.
